thinking: Confluence Action/Outcome notes go stale fast on a living backlog page; cross-referencing live Jira ticket status gives a materially more current and trustworthy completion signal than the page text alone.
followups: Confirm whether a restoration ticket exists for the 88* hard-validation regression
Confirm status of Wonder App Name/Ingredients consolidation and allergen-change-automation asks (tracked in a Slack Cookbook Portal list I could not access)

summary: Queried secure-recipe-prod BigQuery (item_line_builds joined to effective_items) for FOR_SALE, FINAL, effective menu items with line build toggle Is Multi-usage qty Item=true; found 4 items: 2 BYO pizzas (Di Fara 3.0, incl. Pilot) and 2 BRFC smash burgers.
learned: is_multiple_usage column on secure-recipe-prod.recipe_v2.item_line_builds (joined via item_version_id = effective_items._id) is the BQ mapping for the Cookbook UI toggle "Is Multi-usage qty Item"; only 4 current for-sale/final menu items use it (8006447, 8010990, 8011482, 8011483), each with 2-18 distinct line builds.

summary: Queried secure-recipe-prod BigQuery for FOR_SALE, FINAL, effective, non-preset menu items with line build toggle Multi versions vs options=true; found 12 items (steaks with temperature-driven line builds + KBBQ burgers), confirmed no overlap with the earlier Is Multi-usage qty Item=true set (mutually exclusive by design).
learned: is_multiple_version column on secure-recipe-prod.recipe_v2.item_line_builds is the BQ mapping for Cookbook toggle "Multi versions vs options"; 12 current for-sale/final/non-preset menu items use it, none overlapping with the is_multiple_usage set, consistent with the UI rule forbidding both toggles at once.

summary: Corrected methodology: sold_status=SCHEDULED menu item versions are mostly effective=false (372 of 382 rows), so they are invisible in effective_items. Re-ran both line-build-flag queries against item_versions directly (joined via item_version_id=_id) with sold_status IN (FOR_SALE, SCHEDULED) and version_status IN (FINAL, SCHEDULED), presets excluded. Multi-usage set stayed at 4 items but 2 (BRFC Single/Double Smash Burger) now show an additional upcoming SCHEDULED version also carrying the flag. Multi-version set unchanged at 12 items, no SCHEDULED versions found.
learned: effective_items silently drops SCHEDULED (future) item versions since effective=true only marks the currently-live version; any Cookbook query that needs to include upcoming/scheduled menu items must query item_versions directly without the effective=true filter, using sold_status/version_status IN (...) instead.
